items.title: Welcome to Stremio Plus
items.text: A new name and a new icon. Updates now come from this app's own releases: Settings > About > Check for updates.

items.title: Watch party
items.text: Watch the same title in sync from different places. Invite someone on your account, they accept or decline, and leaving only unsyncs them.

items.title: Picture in picture, everywhere
items.text: Press OK on the corner window to bring it back to full screen. Switch between a film and a camera in the corner, and float video on the phone too.

items.title: Cameras: sound and switching
items.text: Camera audio with its own volume and mix, and next and previous camera keys in the corner window and the full-screen viewer.

items.title: Subtitles that recover
items.text: When a subtitle fails, the player moves to the next track or subtitle, and then to the next source.

items.title: Search starts on letters
items.text: The keyboard opens on Q with letters first, and the microphone sits next to the search box.

items.title: Continue Watching order
items.text: Continue Watching now refreshes while a film plays in the corner, so what you watched last comes first.
